title: Sign in to DEEIX Chat
newPasswordPlaceholder: At least 8 characters, not digits only

toasts.accountLocked: Too many failed attempts. This account is locked for another {minutes} minute(s).
toasts.challengeExpired: Two-factor verification expired. Sign in again.
toasts.codeRequired: Enter a verification code or recovery code.
toasts.loginFailed: Sign-in failed. Check your account and password.
toasts.loginRetry: Sign-in failed. Please try again later.
toasts.passwordInvalid: Password must be at least 8 characters and not digits only.
toasts.passwordResetFailed: Password reset failed. Check your email, code, and new password.
toasts.providerStartFailed: Unable to start third-party sign-in. Refresh the page and try again.
toasts.registerFailed: Registration failed. Please try again later.
toasts.providerBridgeRequired: Third-party sign-in is unavailable. Ask your administrator to set PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL.

oauthCallback.missingParams: The third-party sign-in callback is missing required parameters.
oauthCallback.expiredSession: The third-party sign-in session expired. Please sign in again.
oauthCallback.bindSessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again before binding this identity provider.
oauthCallback.loadingDescription: Verifying the third-party identity. Please wait.

emailConflict.title: This email already has an account
emailConflict.description: For account security, the third-party identity cannot be merged directly into an existing account. Sign in to the existing account first, then link the third-party identity in account settings.

sub2api.loadingDescription: Verifying your secure sign-in link. Please wait.
sub2api.invalidLink: This sign-in link is incomplete or invalid. Request a new link and try again.
sub2api.exchangeFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Check your connection or reopen the entry from sub2api. This does not necessarily mean the token expired.
sub2api.sessionBinding: sub2api rejected server verification because the session IP or browser fingerprint changed. Ask the administrator for a dedicated authorization handoff; session binding is not bypassed.
sub2api.tokenRejected: sub2api did not accept the login credential. Sign in to sub2api again and reopen its entry; do not copy the already-cleaned address bar URL.
sub2api.identityMismatch: The link user ID or API Key owner does not match the verified identity. Reopen the entry from the correct account.
sub2api.userInactive: The sub2api user is not active. Check the account status.
sub2api.keyAccessDenied: Identity verification passed, but sub2api denied access to the user's API Keys. Check account permissions and session status.
sub2api.noUsableKey: No eligible Key is available. Check that its group is enabled, it has not expired and it has remaining quota.
sub2api.serviceDisabled: This deployment has not enabled sub2api integration or personal model providers. Contact the administrator.
sub2api.gatewayNotAllowed: The gateway is not trusted by this deployment. Ask the administrator to configure it explicitly.
sub2api.upstreamUnavailable: The sub2api response could not be read. Check connectivity, timeouts or API version compatibility and reopen the entry later.
sub2api.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Reopen the entry later.
sub2api.providerUnavailable: Provider import or model discovery failed. Check host restrictions, provider limits, existing provider status and Key validity.
sub2api.twoFactorFailed: Two-factor verification could not be started. Return to normal sign-in.
sub2api.protocolExpired: Protocol selection expired. Return to sub2api and request a new sign-in link.

importSummary.ready: {count} services are ready. Choose one manually from the model list
importSummary.partial: {count} services are ready; some Keys were not imported
importSummary.none: No services are ready; the following Keys were not imported
importSummary.manualSelection: Ready services can be selected manually in the model list. Keys are never rotated or failed over automatically.
importSummary.noItemDetails: The server did not provide item-level details. Check Key status using the counts above.

reasons.quota: The Key is over quota or its quota is exhausted
reasons.unsupported: The group or model protocol is unsupported
reasons.two-factor: This two-factor account only reuses existing providers. This Key was not imported and verification will not automatically import it
reasons.limit: The personal-provider limit was reached. Adjust the admin limit or remove an unused provider
reasons.timeout: The import time budget was exhausted. Reopen the entry from sub2api to continue
reasons.inactive: The Key or its group is disabled
reasons.key-invalid: The Key format or quota data is invalid
reasons.group-invalid: The Key has no valid assigned group
reasons.gateway: The gateway is not trusted by this deployment
reasons.suspended: The provider was suspended by an administrator and will not be restored automatically
reasons.disabled: The provider is disabled or has no enabled models and will not be restored automatically
reasons.credential-changed: The stored credential, URL or protocol changed. Resolve it in provider settings
reasons.duplicate: The provider identity conflicts with an existing record; nothing was overwritten
reasons.blocked-host: The gateway host is blocked by the deployment security policy
reasons.user-skipped: Skipped by you for this sign-in
reasons.other: Not imported. Try again later or contact the administrator

protocolSelection.title: Choose an API protocol
protocolSelection.description: The platform protocol for these Keys could not be determined. Choose how each Key should be imported, or skip it for this sign-in. No protocol is selected automatically.

passwordLogin.title: Sign in with sub2api
passwordLogin.description: Use your sub2api email and password. This signs in to the Chat account mapped to that same remote identity; no Chat password is created or synchronized.
passwordLogin.remoteTwoFactorDescription: Enter the 6-digit TOTP code from sub2api for {email}. This is separate from Chat two-factor verification.
passwordLogin.boundary: Web browser only. Remote and Chat passwords stay independent, and sub2api administrator status does not grant Chat administrator access.
passwordLogin.openSub2Api: Manage or sign in at sub2api

errors.captcha-unavailable: sub2api verification cannot run on this page. The hostname may not be authorized, or the verification script failed or timed out. Continue at sub2api instead.
errors.disabled: sub2api email sign-in is not enabled for this deployment. Use Chat sign-in or continue at sub2api.
errors.unavailable: sub2api email sign-in is currently unavailable. Its configuration or verification method may be unsupported. Continue at sub2api.
errors.invalid-request: The sub2api sign-in request was not valid. Check the email and start again.
errors.invalid-credentials: sub2api did not accept this email and password. Enter them again; nothing was retried automatically.
errors.captcha-failed: sub2api verification failed. Complete a new verification before signing in again.
errors.remote-two-factor-invalid: The sub2api code was not accepted. Enter a new 6-digit code before the original sign-in expires.
errors.flow-expired: This sub2api sign-in expired. Start again with your email and password.
errors.flow-busy: This sub2api sign-in is already processing another request. Start again if it does not complete.
errors.rate-limited: Too many sub2api sign-in attempts. Wait and try again later.

localLoginMode: Use a Chat local account / administrator
